همِيدٌ (tropical:) Sheep or goats that have died: (L:) or the beasts or the like (مال) that are registered in the government-accounts as due from a man. (ISh, L, K.) You say, آخَذَنَا ??لْهَمِيدِ He (the collector) exacted from us taking for the sheep or goats that had died: (L:) or, taking what was registered as due from us in the governmentaccounts. (ISh, L.) ―
-b2- See هَامِدٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
